definitions.explanation: A medication that induces calm or sleep by reducing nervous system activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれて→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I became sleepy after being given a sedative before surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{興奮|こうふん}した→興奮する：25351_koufunsuru⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}かせる→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sedatives are sometimes used to calm an agitated patient.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鎮静|ちんせい}→鎮静：19769_chinsei⟧ (calming, sedation) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, medicine). Used in medical contexts for medications that reduce anxiety, induce sleep, or calm agitated patients. Not to be confused with pain medication or anesthesia, which have different purposes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — administer a sedative
- {鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ — give a sedative injection
- {鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ — effect of the sedative
- {鎮静剤|ちんせいざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ — the sedative takes effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧ — painkiller, analgesic; reduces pain rather than inducing calm
- ⟦{睡眠薬|すいみんやく}→睡眠薬：28681_suiminyaku⟧ — sleeping pill; specifically induces sleep, while {鎮静剤|ちんせいざい} primarily calms
- ⟦{麻酔|ますい}→麻酔：10581_masui⟧ — anesthesia; eliminates sensation entirely, used for surgical procedures
